subject: Defining the exact audit "cut" for Type II evidence & draft bridge letter
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acmehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Compliance <soc2@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-17T09:15:00-05:00
Subject: Clarify end-of-period instant for your Type II (and bridge letter request)

Hi Logan,

Hope you’re well — we’re preparing our control evidence pack for an upcoming customer audit and need a quick clarification about Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II period. The report we have is dated 2025-03-31. A couple of questions from our auditor: 

1) What exact instant is considered "in-scope" on the report end date? For example, do you consider 2025-03-31 inclusive up to 2025-03-31T23:59:59 UTC, or up to the end of day in local timezone for services (e.g., America/New_York), or some other cut?

2) If there were partial-day operational events (e.g., configuration changes at 15:00 local time on 2025-03-31), are those considered in-scope? Our auditor tends to rely on a clear statement (UTC vs local) when judging point-in-time evidence.

3) Can Redwood provide a short bridge letter that explicitly states the cut instant and what classes of point-in-time artifacts were reviewed (logs, backup manifests, rollforward scripts, snapshot manifests)? If possible, we’d also like a simple mapping that ties high-level services to the artifact types (e.g., inference-gateway -> request logs, model-store -> object snapshots).

Attachments: we’d like to attach the Redwood PDF for internal reference in our tracker (if you can re-send the latest). Can you confirm timeline? Our audit kickoff is the week of 2025-11-24 so a response by 2025-11-20 would be ideal.

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez
Sr. Compliance Manager
Acme Health

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-17T13:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Clarify end-of-period instant for your Type II (and bridge letter request)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear note and timeline. We can do this. Quick answers up front and then a few follow-ups so we give you a precise bridge letter: 

- Default cut instant: Our SOC 2 Type II reports are prepared using evidence that is captured and indexed in UTC. For the March 31, 2025 period, the standard interpretation we provide is that coverage is inclusive through 2025-03-31T23:59:59 UTC (i.e., the full UTC day).

- Partial-day events: Anything captured in our production logs or snapshot manifests with a timestamp <= the cut instant above is considered in-scope. That includes configuration changes, infra events, and object-store snapshots where the artifact timestamp is on or before the cut instant.

- Bridge letter: We can produce a short bridge statement that (a) confirms the cut instant in UTC, (b) lists the artifact classes we used for evidence, and (c) includes a simple mapping of the services and artifact types. I’ve attached the SOC 2 PDF copy we publish and a preliminary bridge letter draft (word doc). Could you confirm whether your auditor would prefer the cut instant expressed in UTC only or also in Acme local time (America/New_York)? Some auditors ask for both to avoid ambiguity.

Proposed next steps: 
1) You confirm timezone preference (UTC only vs UTC + local).
2) We finalize the bridge letter and include the artifacts mapping.
3) We’ll deliver the signed bridge by 2025-11-20 (pending your confirmation) — timeline should be fine on our end.

Attachment: redwood_soc2_type_ii_2024_11.pdf (pdf), bridge_letter_proposed_text.docx (docx)

Regards,
Logan Wright
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-18T08:22:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft wording for bridge letter + recommended mapping

Forwarding a short draft that I think will satisfy the auditor’s checklist. I included a concise artifact mapping and a clause about timezone expression. Please review and send to Sofia if it looks good.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Nov 18, 2025 at 08:20 AM -05:00
Subject: Draft bridge letter wording

Logan / Karthik — draft copy below (can be placed on company letterhead and signed by our compliance lead):

"Bridge Letter — SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2025-03-31)

Redwood Inference confirms that the SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2025-03-31 was prepared using evidence collected and indexed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). For the avoidance of doubt, the effective cut instant for the report is 2025-03-31T23:59:59 UTC. Artifacts considered in the engagement included: system and application logs, configuration-management records, backup and snapshot manifests, and administrative change records.

For customers or auditors that prefer a local-time expression, Redwood can additionally state the equivalent instant in the customer’s local timezone; for example, 2025-03-31T19:59:59-04:00 (America/New_York) for Eastern Daylight Time.

Artifact mapping (high level):
- inference-gateway: request logs (log-retention index), streaming session manifests
- model-store: object snapshots (manifest + checksum)
- control-plane: config-change records and deployment events (audit trail)
- telemetry/metrics: aggregated rollups and per-instance trace spans

If this wording is acceptable we should: (a) place on letterhead, (b) have Compliance sign it, and (c) attach it to the SOC 2 PDF.

"

Notes: I kept the mapping intentionally high level (auditors usually ask to avoid too much internal implementation detail). If you want we can include service endpoints (api.redwood.run, s3-models.redwood.run) but I recommend doing that only if Acme specifically requests it.

Naomi
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acmehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Compliance <soc2@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-18T13:04:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Defining the exact audit "cut" for Type II evidence & draft bridge letter

Logan — thanks, that reads well and the UTC instant is fine for our auditor. A couple of small asks before we close this out: 

- Please include the equivalent local-time expression for America/New_York in the final bridge letter (the example you gave is perfect).
- In the artifact mapping, can you add a one-line explicit note that snapshots with timestamps <= the cut instant were included (we just need the short sentence for our evidence matrix).
- We’d like the signed bridge letter and the SOC 2 PDF by 2025-11-20 COB. Can you confirm delivery by then?

If you can send the updated doc as a Drive link and a signed PDF that will be easiest for our tracker.

Thanks again — will loop in our lead auditor if we need anything further.

Best,
Sofia Martinez
Sr. Compliance Manager
Acme Health
